title: MethaneSAT Permian Basin — Senate investigation into methane mismatch
snippet: Senator Whitehouse launches investigation into alarming mismatch between reported methane emissions and actual emissions in Permian Basin. MethaneSAT data shows observed methane 410 metric tons/hour vs EPA reported 104 mt/hr — 4× higher. Investigation targets EPA's reliance on industry-reported data.
tag_reason: MethaneSAT 데이터 기반 미 상원 조사 개시는 신규 — 이전 보고서의 MethaneSAT 평가(src-009)와 관련되나 정책적 파급 효과가 새로운 이벤트.
